description: Turns a factory into an Agent Skill folder: <id>/SKILL.md (what it produces, inputs to collect, every step and who does it, where to stop and ask the person to approve) and <id>/factory/ (the files unchanged, plus a foreman written from the flow when the author wrote none). With out_dir, writes the folder there; without, returns SKILL.md and the file list.
name: export_skill
title: Export as an Agent Skill
